brief_assessment: Shows warmth and identifies both parents’ protective motives, but relies heavily on occupational stereotypes and unsupported mind-reading. Repeated compromise proposals assume unwanted STEM participation, adjustable rehearsals, and arbitrary time limits without exploring actual constraints or Noah’s preferences. Language about suppression and seeing Noah’s humanity compromises neutrality. The debrief identifies missing trust and child participation, but reinforces speculation and inaccurately claims earlier validation was absent.
